title: Making Settings for Business Partners
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

In ascenario with SAP CRM as your leading system, newly created business partner master records and subsequent changes — as
long as the necessary settings have been made — are distributed automatically from the CRM system to the S/4HANA system.

If you use the appropriate CRM partner roles, then the system creates the customer or vendor master records synchronously, or
updates them, as depicted in the following table.

SAP CRM                            SAP S/4HANA | Synchronized Master Data

CRMO000 Sold-to party             FLCU0O             Customer master record with FI data
FLUCO1             Customer master record with sales data
MKK                 Contract Partner

BBPOQOO Supplier                   FLVNOO             Vendor master record with Fl data
FLVNO1             Vendor master record with sales data
MKK                 Contract Partner

If you are using only SAP S/4HANA, then the system synchronizes and updates the master data as depicted in the following table:

SAP S/4HANA: Role Grouping                SAP S/4HANA: Role      Synchronized Master Data

FSCRO1X VP with customer integration _ FLCU0O                       Customer master record with Fl data
FLUCO1                       Customer master record with sales data
MKK                          Contract Partner

FSCRO2X VP with vendor integration        FLVNOO                       Vendor master record with Fl data
FLVNO1                        Vendor master record with sales data
MKK                          Contract Partner

i Note

If you want to create the business partner with a customer or vendor, then you first have to compare the required fields of the
customer and vendor master record with those of the business partner. If you create a business partner in SAP S/4HANA of the

type ‘person’, then you have to make sure that it is possible to enter the correspondence language. Only then is it possible for
the synchronization to take place using CVI. If errors occur during the synchronization, you can get help in the Business Data

Toolset by removing the function module BUA BUPA EVENT FMOD2 for field group 62 Business Data Toolset. To do so, in the
menu for the Business Data Toolset (transaction BUPT), choose |}Business Partner } Control » Screen Layout » Field Groups

1 Note

During the replication of business partners from SAP CRM to SAP ERP, the standard system sets the Relevant for agency
business indicator for the customers created using CVI.

Making Settings for Business Partners
